# Kontent.ai

Kontent.ai is a headless CMS that delivers content via API, allowing developers to build websites and applications using their preferred frameworks, languages, or libraries.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/kontent-ai/.

## Actions

- **Get Content Item**: Retrieve a specific content item by its identifier.
- **Get Language**: Retrieve a specific language by its id.
- **Get Language Variant**: Retrieve a specific language variant of a content item.
- **List Content Items**: List content items from the delivery api.
- **List Content Types**: List content types within a kontent.ai environment.
- **List Languages**: List languages in a kontent.ai project.
